decision_conditions: Cycle and car parking cannot be satisfactorily provided within the curtilage of the site to meet the Council's requirements in respect of the development, and the likely increase in parking on the neighbouring highways would be detrimental to the free flow and safety of traffic on the neighbouring highways and the amenity of neighbouring residents, contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies T5 and T6 of The London Plan (2021), Policy CS.1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM42 of the Development Management Plan Local Policies (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and Policies GR1, M2 and M3 of the emerging Local Plan.&nbsp;

<p>The proposed new dwelling, by reason of its poor design, size, scale, proportions and siting would appear contrived, cramped and out of keeping with the wider pattern of development to the detriment of the character and appearance of the streetscene, and the pattern of development within the surrounding area. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the high-quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3 and D6 of The London Plan (2021), Policy CS.1B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Plan Local Policies (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>

<p>The proposed dwelling, by reason of the site characteristics, layout and relationship with neighbouring properties would have a detrimental impact upon the residential amenities of future occupants of the property.&nbsp; There would be inadequate amenity space for residents to enjoy and the layout of the property in relation to the boundaries of the site would provide a poor outlook for future residents. The proposal would therefore be contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3 of The London Plan (2021), Policy CS.1B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Plan Local Policies (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>
description: Construction of one single storey detached dwellinghouse (1 x 1 bed); landscaping
